#!/bin/bash
# Local execution script to automate the Metacentrum workflow

# --- CONFIGURATION ---
META_USER="xszabo16"
META_SERVER="skirit.metacentrum.cz" 
LOCAL_DATA_DIR="./raw_dataset/"
LOCAL_OUTPUT_DIR="./processed_dataset/"
META_WORK_DIR="/storage/brno2/home/$META_USER/eeg_project"
GITHUB_REPO="https://github.com/TheRealTom/datalz.git"


echo "[1/5] Syncing Raw Data to Metacentrum ($META_SERVER)..."
ssh $META_USER@$META_SERVER "mkdir -p $META_WORK_DIR/data $META_WORK_DIR/output"
rsync -avz --progress $LOCAL_DATA_DIR $META_USER@$META_SERVER:$META_WORK_DIR/data/

echo "[2/5] Setting up Git Repository on Metacentrum..."
ssh $META_USER@$META_SERVER "
    cd $META_WORK_DIR;
    if [ ! -d 'repo' ]; then
        git clone $GITHUB_REPO repo;
    else
        cd repo && git pull;
    fi
"

echo "[3/5] Submitting PBS Job (GPU Queue)..."
JOB_ID=$(ssh $META_USER@$META_SERVER "cat << 'EOF' > $META_WORK_DIR/job_gpu.sh
#!/bin/bash
#PBS -N eeg_amica_gpu
#PBS -q gpu
#PBS -l select=1:ncpus=4:mem=64gb:ngpus=1:scratch_local=10gb
#PBS -l walltime=02:00:00
#PBS -j oe

# Load necessary modules for Python and GPU
module add python/3.10.4
module add cuda/12.1

# Setup virtual environment
cd $META_WORK_DIR/repo
python -m venv venv_gpu
source venv_gpu/bin/activate

# Install MNE, CuPy (matching the loaded CUDA module) for GPU acceleration
pip install --upgrade pip
pip install mne mne-icalabel pydantic python-dotenv cupy-cuda12x

# NOTE: Make sure your amica_python wrapper is installed here as well
# pip install amica_python (or however you distribute it)

export DATASET_DIR=$META_WORK_DIR/data
export OUTPUT_DIR=$META_WORK_DIR/output
export LOG_FILE=$META_WORK_DIR/output/processing_log.txt

# Force MNE/NumPy to limit thread usage so they don't oversubscribe CPU while waiting for GPU
export OMP_NUM_THREADS=1
export MKL_NUM_THREADS=1

python parallelPreprocessing.py
EOF
qsub $META_WORK_DIR/job_gpu.sh")

echo "Job submitted with ID: $JOB_ID"

echo "[4/5] Waiting for GPU job completion..."
while ssh $META_USER@$META_SERVER "qstat -f $JOB_ID" | grep -q "job_state = [R|Q]"; do
    sleep 60
    echo -n "."
done
echo " Job finished!"

echo "[5/5] Downloading processed data back to Local PC..."
mkdir -p $LOCAL_OUTPUT_DIR
rsync -avz --progress $META_USER@$META_SERVER:$META_WORK_DIR/output/ $LOCAL_OUTPUT_DIR

echo "Pipeline complete. Processed data is in $LOCAL_OUTPUT_DIR."

#!/bin/sh
#PBS -l walltime=00:10:00
#PBS -l select=1:ncpus=1:mem=10GB
#PBS -J 1-42


# --- template input directory (one "base case") ---
TEMPLATE="$HOME/Re-Genesis/oxDNA/alex/force_dist_array_fullrod/template/"

# --- parameter table ---
PARAMS="$HOME/Re-Genesis/oxDNA/alex/force_dist_array_fullrod/params.tsv"

# --- which array index am I? ---
IDX="${PBS_ARRAY_INDEX:-${PBS_ARRAYID:-1}}"

# --- read k and r0 from the table line matching IDX ---
KR="$(awk -v i="$IDX" '
  $0 ~ /^#/ {next}
  NF>=3 && $1==i {print $2, $3; exit}
' "$PARAMS")"

if [ -z "$KR" ]; then
  echo "Could not find parameters for index $IDX in $PARAMS" >&2
  exit 1
fi

k="$(echo "$KR" | awk '{print $1}')"
r0="$(echo "$KR" | awk '{print $2}')"

# --- format k like 0.75 -> 075, 0.25 -> 025 ---
k_tag="$(printf "%.0f" "$(awk -v k="$k" 'BEGIN{print k*100}')")"
k_tag="$(printf "%03d" "$k_tag")"   # zero-pad to 3 digits

# --- format r0 like 2.0 -> 2, 4.0 -> 4, 6.0 -> 6 ---

  if (r == int(r)) printf "%d", int(r);

    grep '' $tst/$src2.devtest | \
        python $TOKENIZER_CUSTOM > $fs_res/tmp/test.$src.tok
else
    grep '' $tst/$src2.devtest | \
        perl $TOKENIZER -threads 16 -a -l $src > $fs_res/tmp/test.$src.tok
fi

checkpoints=("1" "2" "3" "4" "5" "6" "7" "8" "_best")

        cat $fs_res/tmp/test.$src.tok | \
        python $FSROOT/interactive.py $fs_data \

#!/bin/sh
#PBS -q q512G
#PBS -l nodes=1:ppn=1,mem=10gb,walltime=96:00:00
#PBS -e /p300s/apod/lihy/dy_data/rubish/err.out
#PBS -o /p300s/apod/lihy/dy_data/rubish/std.out
#HSCHED -s hschedd

. ~/.bash_profile
conda activate D_division
cd Mpox

generate_month_ranges() {
    local start_year=$1
    local start_month=$2
    local end_year=$3
    local end_month=$4
    local ranges=()

    local current_year=$start_year
    local current_month=$start_month
    local division=0

    while [[ $current_year -lt $end_year || ($current_year -eq $end_year && $current_month -lt $end_month) ]]; do
        next_year=$current_year
        next_month=$((current_month + 1))
        if [[ $next_month -gt 12 ]]; then
            next_month=1
            next_year=$((current_year + 1))
        fi
        ranges+=("$current_year $(printf "%02d" $current_month) $next_year $(printf "%02d" $next_month) $division")
        current_year=$next_year
        current_month=$next_month
        division=1  # 从第二次循环开始，division 设置为 1
    done

    echo "${ranges[@]}"
}

# 生成2021年01月到2024年11月的月份范围数组
month_ranges=($(generate_month_ranges 2022 01 2024 11))

# 将 month_ranges 数组每五个元素组成一个新数组
new_arrays=()
temp_array=()
count=0

for range in "${month_ranges[@]}"; do
    temp_array+=("$range")
    count=$((count + 1))
    if [[ $count -eq 5 ]]; then
        new_arrays+=("$(IFS=' '; echo "${temp_array[*]}")")
        temp_array=()
        count=0
    fi
done
# 如果 temp_array 中还有剩余的元素，将它们添加到 new_arrays 中
if [[ ${#temp_array[@]} -ne 0 ]]; then
    new_arrays+=("(${temp_array[@]})")
fi


# 定义一个函数来执行Python脚本
run_python_script() {
    local start_year=$1
    local start_month=$2
    local end_year=$3
    local end_month=$4
    local division=$5

    python dynamic_div/D_division_newname_v9.py "$start_year" "$start_month" "$end_year" "$end_month" "$division" > "log/run_dd_${start_year}_${start_month}-${end_year}_${end_month}.log" 2>&1
}

# 遍历 new_arrays 数组并调用函数
for new_array in "${new_arrays[@]}"; do
    # 打印当前的 new_array
    echo "Processing new array: $new_array"
    # 将 new_array 拆分为范围
    read -r start_year start_month end_year end_month division <<< "$new_array"
    # 调用函数
    run_python_script "$start_year" "$start_month" "$end_year" "$end_month" "$division"
done

# 执行最终的Python脚本
python ../Division_compare.py Static_division 2022 01 2024 11 > "log/run_dc_$(date +"%m-%d").log" 2>&1

# 熵计算
# 这里并未设置参数去调整计算哪个时间段的熵，需要根据具体需求在代码中进行调整
python entropy/entropy_mon_small.py >log/run_env_small.log 2>&1

echo "Indexing begun at..."
date


FILE1=$WORK/Constant_Call50pv1.ld

FILE3=$WORK/Constant_Call20pv1.ld
FILE4=$WORK/Constant_Reads20pv1.ld
FILE5=$WORK/Constant_Call10pv1.ld
FILE6=$WORK/Constant_Reads10pv1.ld
FILE7=$WORK/Constant_Call5pv1.ld
FILE8=$WORK/Constant_Reads5pv1.ld

LEN1=`cat $FILE1 | wc -l`
echo "Removing rows with r^2 value of 0"
awk '(NR>0) && ($4 > 0)' $FILE1 > FullIndex.$PBS_ARRAY_INDEX.0
LEN2=`cat FullIndex.$PBS_ARRAY_INDEX.0 | wc -l`
DIFF_LEN=$((LEN1-LEN2))
echo "Number of rows removed:" $DIFF_LEN
echo "New length:" $LEN2

PREV_STEP=0
STEP=1
for file in $FILE2 $FILE3 $FILE4 $FILE5 $FILE6 $FILE7 $FILE8 
do
echo "Cross referencing with" $file
awk 'NR==FNR{a[$1,$2]=$4;next} ($1,$2) in a{print $1,$2,$3,a[$1,$2]}' FullIndex.$PBS_ARRAY_INDEX.$PREV_STEP $file > FullIndex.$PBS_ARRAY_INDEX.$STEP    
TEMP_LEN=`cat FullIndex.$PBS_ARRAY_INDEX.$STEP | wc -l`
rm FullIndex.$PBS_ARRAY_INDEX.$PREV_STEP
echo "New length:" $TEMP_LEN
PREV_STEP=$((PREV_STEP+1))
STEP=$((STEP+1))
done

echo "Reference file created"
LEN3=`cat FullIndex.$PBS_ARRAY_INDEX.$PREV_STEP | wc -l`
echo "Final number of sites:" $LEN3

if [ $PBS_ARRAY_INDEX = 1 ]; then
INDEX_FILE=$FILE1
elif [ $PBS_ARRAY_INDEX = 2 ]; then
INDEX_FILE=$FILE2
elif [ $PBS_ARRAY_INDEX = 3 ]; then
INDEX_FILE=$FILE3
elif [ $PBS_ARRAY_INDEX = 4 ]; then
INDEX_FILE=$FILE4
elif [ $PBS_ARRAY_INDEX = 5 ]; then
INDEX_FILE=$FILE5
elif [ $PBS_ARRAY_INDEX = 6 ]; then
INDEX_FILE=$FILE6
elif [ $PBS_ARRAY_INDEX = 7 ]; then
INDEX_FILE=$FILE7
elif [ $PBS_ARRAY_INDEX = 8 ]; then
INDEX_FILE=$FILE8
fi

echo "Indexing data file: " $INDEX_FILE
awk 'NR==FNR{a[$1,$2]=$4;next} ($1,$2) in a{print $1,$2,$3,a[$1,$2],$4}' FullIndex.$PBS_ARRAY_INDEX.$PREV_STEP $INDEX_FILE > Idx.$PBS_ARRAY_INDEX
LEN3=`cat Idx.$PBS_ARRAY_INDEX | wc -l`
echo "Length of new data file" $LEN3

echo "Adding column for standard bias calculation"
awk 'NR>0{printf("%s %6.6f\n", $0, ($5-$4)/$4)}' Idx.$PBS_ARRAY_INDEX > Calc1.$PBS_ARRAY_INDEX
rm Idx.$PBS_ARRAY_INDEX

echo "Adding column for root mean square deviation calculation"
awk 'NR>0{printf("%s %7.6f\n", $0, ($5-$4)^2)}' Calc1.$PBS_ARRAY_INDEX > $INDEX_FILE.idx
LEN4=`cat $INDEX_FILE.idx | wc -l`
echo "Length of final file:" $LEN4
rm Calc1.$PBS_ARRAY_INDEX

echo "Full processing completed"

SB=$(awk '{s+=$6}END{print s}' $INDEX_FILE.idx)
SUM_RMSD=$(awk '{s+=$7}END{print s}' $INDEX_FILE.idx)
RMSD=$(echo "scale=6;sqrt($SUM_RMSD/$LEN4)" | bc)

echo "Standard Bias:" $SB
echo "Root Mean Square Deviation" $RMSD

#!/bin/bash
#PBS -l walltime=01:00:00
#PBS -l select=1:ncpus=4:ngpus=1:mem=16gb:gpu_type=RTX6000
#PBS -N evaluate_clip_models
#PBS -o evaluate_clip_models_out.txt
#PBS -e evaluate_clip_models_err.txt

cd "$PBS_O_WORKDIR"

module load anaconda3/4.3.1
source activate fyp_fixed      

module unload anaconda3          
module load cuda/11.7.0
module load gcc/11.3.0           

export LD_LIBRARY_PATH="$CONDA_PREFIX/lib:$LD_LIBRARY_PATH"

{
  echo "🚀 Started model evaluation at: $(date)"
  
  python evaluate_all_clip_models.py
  
  python - <<EOF
import pandas as pd
import os
import glob
import numpy as np

# Find all class and overall metrics files
class_files = glob.glob('results/FT_*_P_*/evaluation/class_metrics.csv')
overall_files = glob.glob('results/FT_*_P_*/evaluation/overall_metrics.csv')

# Create summary tables
model_summary = []

# Extract model names and organize by FT and P values
for overall_file in overall_files:
    model_dir = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(overall_file))
    model_name = os.path.basename(model_dir)
    
    # Parse FT and P values
    parts = model_name.split('_')
    ft = int(parts[1])
    p = int(parts[3])
    
    # Load overall metrics
    overall_df = pd.read_csv(overall_file)
    
    # Load class metrics for this model
    class_file = os.path.join(model_dir, 'evaluation', 'class_metrics.csv')
    class_df = pd.read_csv(class_file)
    
    # Extract key metrics
    metrics = {
        'Model': model_name,
        'FT': ft,
        'P': p,
        'Accuracy': overall_df['accuracy'].iloc[0],
        'Macro F1': overall_df['macro_f1'].iloc[0],
        'Top-3 Accuracy': overall_df.get('top3_accuracy', [np.nan])[0],
    }
    
    # Add per-class F1 scores
    for _, row in class_df.iterrows():
        class_name = row['class_name']
        metrics[f'{class_name} F1'] = row['f1_score']
        metrics[f'{class_name} Prec'] = row['precision']
        metrics[f'{class_name} Rec'] = row['recall']
    
    model_summary.append(metrics)

# Create dataframe and sort by performance
if model_summary:
    summary_df = pd.DataFrame(model_summary)
    summary_df = summary_df.sort_values(by=['Accuracy', 'Macro F1'], ascending=False)
    
    # Write to CSV
    summary_df.to_csv('results/model_comparison_full.csv', index=False)
    
    # Create a more readable summary for the paper
    paper_summary = summary_df[['Model', 'Accuracy', 'Macro F1', 'Top-3 Accuracy']].copy()
    paper_summary.to_csv('results/model_comparison_paper.csv', index=False)
    
    print("Created model summary tables:")
    print(paper_summary.round(4).head())
else:
    print("No models found to summarize")
EOF
  
  echo "✅ Finished evaluation at: $(date)"
  
} > evaluate_all_models_full.log 2>&1

########
## This is a template to create a submission script
## to do the first step in our ddRAD analysis pipeline.

## Specifically, this script will:
## (1) use the process_radtags function of STACKS to demultiplex the raw reads

## This script is meant to be copied into a new SS with a descriptive filename.
## Then, you can change the parameters as necessary and submit the whole script.

########
## Necessary inputs:
## (1) forward reads (FASTQ format)
## (2) reverse reads (FASTQ format)
## (3) a barcode file explaining the barcodes used for each sample

## Outputs:
## (1) a folder of .fq files for each individual sample

########
## SET PARAMETERS AND ARGUMENTS
## This is the part of the script you will change, possibly each time
## First, change the appropriate stuff in the PBS header (lines 3-11).
## Walltime for one library of 48 individuals should be XXXXXX

## Path to R1 reads
R1='/home/tjthurm/barrett_tim/reads/novaseq/take2_S4/reads/NS.1093.003.Index_6.anolis_lib12_R1.fastq.gz'

## Path to R2 reads
R2='/home/tjthurm/barrett_tim/reads/novaseq/take2_S4/reads/NS.1093.003.Index_6.anolis_lib12_R2.fastq.gz'
## Path to barcode file
BC='/home/tjthurm/barrett_tim/reads/novaseq/barcode_files/lib12_barcode_sample.txt'

## Path to output directory
## NOTE: this script will create one results folder, named in the form of name_DATE.
## You need to supply what you want the name field to include,
## and the location where you want the results folder to be created.
## The location must be an already existing directory.
LOCATION='/home/tjthurm/barrett_tim/demulti/novaseq/s4_run' # must be single quote, exclude trailing slash
NAME="lib_12_clean_noradCheck" #must be double quote


########
## LEAVE THE FOLLOWING CODE UNCHANGED
## save the date as a variable, will incorporate this into filenames later to help reproducibility
dt='date +%m_%d_%Y'
# make toplevel result folder
resOut=$LOCATION"/"$NAME"_"`$dt`
mkdir $resOut

# make variables for the fastq subfolder, then make it
fqOut=$resOut"/fastq"
remOut=$resOut"/rem"
mkdir $fqOut
mkdir $remOut

## Demultiplex with process_radtags
# Source the Compute Canada software
source /software/soft.computecanada.ca.sh
# Load stacks
module load stacks/1.46

## explanation of flags
# -1 path to R1 reads, saved from above
# -2 path to R2 reads, saved from above
# -b path to barcode file, saved from above
# -c drop any read with an N
# -i input file type, fastq. Default is for output to be the same
# DIFFERENT FROM BEFORE:
# --inline_index. usually we do inline_index, but these R2 reads don't have the library index in the header. Not sure if its because we only had one library, and thus one index?
# --renz_1 and --renz_2: the restriction enzymes used
# --disable_rad_check - don't check to see if restriction site is intact
process_radtags -P -1 $R1 -2 $R2 -b $BC -o $fqOut --renz_1 nlaIII --renz_2 mluCI -r -c -i gzfastq -y fastq --inline_index --disable_rad_check

cd $fqOut
mv *.rem.* ../rem

# PBS -m a covers scheduler aborts; this catches ordinary nonzero exits.
# Send only inside a real PBS job, never from a CPU DRY_RUN.
cmip6_notify_failure() {
  local status="$1"
  trap - EXIT
  if (( status != 0 )) && [[ "${DRY_RUN:-0}" != 1 && -n "${PBS_JOBID:-}" ]]; then
    if command -v mail >/dev/null 2>&1 && command -v timeout >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      if ! {

        printf 'Job name: %s\n' "${PBS_JOBNAME:-unknown}"
        printf 'Host: %s\n' "${HOSTNAME:-unknown}"
        printf 'Exit status: %s\n' "${status}"
        printf 'Config: %s\n' "${config:-not reached}"
        printf 'PBS log directory: %s\n' "${CMIP6_PBS_LOG_DIR}"
      } | timeout --kill-after=5s 30s mail -S sendwait \
          -s "[StormSurge FAILED] ${PBS_JOBNAME:-CMIP6} ${PBS_JOBID} exit=${status}" "${CMIP6_MAIL_TO}"; then
        printf '[WARN] Failure email could not be sent to %s; original exit status=%s.\n' "${CMIP6_MAIL_TO}" "${status}" >&2
      fi
    else
      printf '[WARN] Failure email requires mail and timeout on the execution node; original exit status=%s.\n' "${status}" >&2
    fi
  fi
  exit "${status}"
}

#!/bin/bash
#PBS -l select=1:ncpus=8:mem=35gb:scratch_local=150gb
#PBS -l walltime=12:00:00
#PBS -N fasterq_dump

# Set umask for proper group permissions
umask 007

# Set all possible temp directories to scratch (before any tool loading)
export TMPDIR=$SCRATCH
export TMP=$SCRATCH
export TEMP=$SCRATCH
export NCBI_HOME=$SCRATCH
export VDB_CONFIG=$SCRATCH

fasterq_dump_path="/path/to/sratoolkit/bin/fasterq-dump"

output_dir="/path/to/output/raw"
srr_list="/path/to/srr_list.txt"

# Create output directory and work in scratch first
mkdir -p $output_dir
cd $SCRATCH
cp $srr_list $SCRATCH/
srr_list="$SCRATCH/$(basename $srr_list)"

echo "Starting SRA downloads in scratch directory: $SCRATCH"
echo "Final output will be synced to: $output_dir"

while read srr; do
    echo "Processing $srr..."

    # Download to scratch for performance
    $fasterq_dump_path $srr --split-files --threads 8

    # Compress the files
    gzip ${srr}_*.fastq

    # Sync files to project directory with proper group permissions
    for file in ${srr}_*.fastq.gz; do
        if [[ -f "$file" ]]; then
            echo "Syncing $file to $output_dir"
            sync_with_group your_group "$file" "$output_dir/$file"
        fi
    done

    # Clean up scratch files
    rm -f ${srr}_*.fastq.gz

    echo "Finished processing $srr"
done < $srr_list

echo "All downloads completed and synced with proper permissions!"

clean_scratch

import os, time
import torch
import torch.distributed as dist

dist.init_process_group("mpi")
rank = dist.get_rank()
world = dist.get_world_size()

ng = torch.cuda.device_count()
torch.cuda.set_device(rank % ng)

def bench(n_elems, iters=200, warmup=20):
    x = torch.ones(n_elems, device="cuda", dtype=torch.float32)
    torch.cuda.synchronize()
    for _ in range(warmup):
        dist.all_reduce(x)
    torch.cuda.synchronize()

    t0 = time.time()
    for _ in range(iters):
        dist.all_reduce(x)
    torch.cuda.synchronize()
    t1 = time.time()

    dt = (t1 - t0) / iters
    nbytes = x.numel() * x.element_size()
    # effective bandwidth for allreduce ~ 2*(p-1)/p * nbytes / dt (ring model)
    bw = (2*(world-1)/world) * (nbytes / dt) / 1e9
    if rank == 0:
        print(f"world={world} bytes={nbytes} dt={dt*1e3:.3f} ms  est_bw={bw:.2f} GB/s")

for n in [256*1024, 1024*1024, 16*1024*1024]:  # 1MB, 4MB, 64MB (float32)
    bench(n)
PY

#   output/mstts_backchannel_inject/input_inj{0.6,1.0})を 低温(audio0.6/0.8)で生成。
#   狙い: 低温=明瞭を保ったまま、挿入相槌で重なりを出す。
#   判定: 重なり率が非注入(at0.6=0.2%/at0.8=1.1%)より明確に上がり、CERが低温並みなら成功
#         = モデルが挿入相槌をAに"被せて"鳴らしている。重なりが上がらなければ逐次micro-turn。
set -euxo pipefail
echo "JOB_ID=$PBS_JOBID"
cd "$PBS_O_WORKDIR"

module purge
module load cuda/12.6/12.6.1
module load hpcx/2.20
module load python/3.12/3.12.9
uv sync --python 3.12
export VIRTUAL_ENV="$PWD/.venv"
export PATH="$VIRTUAL_ENV/bin:$PATH"
export NO_TORCH_COMPILE=1
export HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1
export NCCL_DEBUG=INFO

export NCCL_NVLS_ENABLE=0

# config = "input_subdir audio_temp"

  "input_inj0.6 0.6"
  "input_inj1.0 0.6"
  "input_inj0.6 0.8"
)

for cfg in "${CONFIGS[@]}"; do
  read -r INSUB AT <<< "$cfg"
  INPUT="$BASE/$INSUB"
  [ -d "$INPUT" ] || { echo "FATAL: missing $INPUT"; exit 1; }
  TAG="${INSUB}_at${AT}"
  OUT="$BASE/gen_$TAG"; mkdir -p "$OUT"

  cd ..

  echo "=== overlap+CER $TAG ==="

    echo "Starting cycle $i of $NUM_CYCLES"

    # Find the last restart file at 00:00:00
    RESTART_FILE=$(ls -t restart.*_00.00.00.nc | head -n 1)
    
    if [ -z "$RESTART_FILE" ]; then
        echo "Error: No restart file found!"
        exit 1
    fi
    
    echo "Found restart file: $RESTART_FILE"
    
    # Extract the date from the restart file (format: restart.YYYY-MM-DD_HH.MM.SS.nc)
    RESTART_DATE=$(echo $RESTART_FILE | sed 's/restart\.\(.*\)_00\.00\.00\.nc/\1/')

    mkdir -p hidden
    
    # Move all restart and diag files with timestamps after the chosen restart file

    echo "Moving newer diag files to hidden folder..."

    # Move diag files (except the 00.00.00 file)
    DIAG_FILE="diag.${RESTART_DATE}_00.00.00.nc"
    for file in diag.${RESTART_DATE}_*.nc; do
        if [ -f "$file" ] && [ "$file" != "$DIAG_FILE" ]; then

        fi

        exit 1
    fi
    
    # Construct the cycled restart file name
    CYCLED_RESTART="cycled_${RESTART_FILE}"
    
    # Check if the cycled restart file was produced
    if [ ! -f "$CYCLED_RESTART" ]; then
        echo "Error: Expected output file $CYCLED_RESTART not found!"
        exit 1
    fi
    
    echo "Cycled restart file created: $CYCLED_RESTART"
    
    # Rename the original restart file
    ORIGINAL_RESTART="original_${RESTART_FILE}"
    mv "$RESTART_FILE" "$ORIGINAL_RESTART"
    echo "Renamed $RESTART_FILE to $ORIGINAL_RESTART"
    
    # Link the cycled restart file to replace the original restart file
    ln -sf "$CYCLED_RESTART" "$RESTART_FILE"
    echo "Linked $CYCLED_RESTART to $RESTART_FILE"
    
    # Convert restart date format to namelist format (YYYY-MM-DD_HH:MM:SS)
    NAMELIST_DATE="${RESTART_DATE}_00:00:00"
    echo "Setting restart date to: $NAMELIST_DATE"
    
    # Update namelist.atmosphere with the restart date and ensure restart is enabled
    sed -i "s/config_start_time = '.*'/config_start_time = '${NAMELIST_DATE}'/" namelist.atmosphere
    sed -i "s/config_do_restart = .*/config_do_restart = true/" namelist.atmosphere
    
    echo "Updated namelist.atmosphere with restart date and enabled restart"
    
    echo "Cycle $i completed successfully"
    echo "----------------------------------------"
done

echo "All cycles completed!"

./filewatcher.sh
wait

cd "$REPO" || exit 1
SEED="${SEED:-0}"
CONFIG="${CONFIG:-src/configs/archive/rotation_aware_freeman.yaml}"
# STAGE=evaluate (default): out-of-fold evaluation + compare of the trained folds.
# STAGE=zero-shot: score one private checkpoint (RUN_ID, ROTATION_CONFIG) zero-shot.

    --run-id "$RUN_ID" --rotation-config "${ROTATION_CONFIG:-src/configs/archive/rotation_aware.yaml}"
  status=$?

exit $status

#PBS -N test_hermitian_N1024_mode1_plt
#PBS -A AbacusAurora

cd $PBS_O_WORKDIR

# Load modules
# Note: frameworks module provides MPI and OpenMP
# fftw module provides FFTW libraries
echo "Loading frameworks module..."
module load frameworks
echo "Loading FFTW module..."
module load fftw/3.3.10

# Check what's available after loading modules
echo "Checking MPI compiler..."
which mpicc
mpicc --version || echo "mpicc not found or error"

echo "Checking C++ compiler..."
which mpicxx
mpicxx --version || echo "mpicxx not found or error"

# Go to hermitian_3d_matrix_production directory
cd /home/helenshao/InitialConditions/hermitian_3d_matrix_production

# Compile with double precision, VERIFY_HERMITIAN_SYMMETRY=1 flag, and verification enabled
# Makefile auto selects correct FFTW libs based on CFLAGS
echo "Compiling hermitian_3d_matrix with double precision..."
echo "VERIFY_HERMITIAN_SYMMETRY: MODE 1 (F=0, H=0 for purely real test + verification checks)"
echo "Verification: ENABLED (PRINT_DETAILED_SLICES, VERIFY_HERMITIAN_SYMMETRY)"
echo "Using SPLINE_RESOLUTION=512 for higher interpolation accuracy"
echo "PRINT_Z_SLABS=1: Will print selected Z-slabs (Z=0, 1, N/2, N-1) for verification"
make clean
make CFLAGS="-DUSE_DOUBLE_PRECISION -DVERIFY_HERMITIAN_SYMMETRY=1 -DPRINT_DETAILED_SLICES=1 -DPRINT_Z_SLABS=1 -DSKIP_VERIFICATION=0 -DSPLINE_RESOLUTION=512"

# Verify executable was created
if [ ! -f "./hermitian_3d_matrix" ]; then
    echo "ERROR: Compilation failed - executable not found!"
    exit 1
fi
echo "Compilation successful - executable found"

# Job parameters
NNODES=$(sort -u $PBS_NODEFILE | wc -l)
NRANKS_PER_NODE=16
NTHREADS_PER_RANK=2
NTOTRANKS=$((NNODES * NRANKS_PER_NODE))

# OpenMP settings
export OMP_NUM_THREADS=$NTHREADS_PER_RANK
export OMP_PLACES=cores
export OMP_PROC_BIND=close

# Test parameters
N=1024
PARAM_FILE="examples/param_N1024_plt.par"

# Check if parameter file exists
if [ ! -f "$PARAM_FILE" ]; then
    echo "ERROR: Parameter file not found: $PARAM_FILE"
    exit 1
fi

echo "=========================================="
echo "Test: Hermitian Symmetry Test Mode 1 (F=0, H=0) with PLT ENABLED"
echo "Double Precision Build"
echo "VERIFY_HERMITIAN_SYMMETRY: MODE 1 (sets F=0, H=0 + enables verification)"
echo "Verification: ENABLED"
echo "Spline Resolution: 512 (high accuracy)"
echo "PLT: ENABLED (using eigenmodes from zeldovich-PLT)"
echo "PLT Rescaling: ENABLED (target_z = 0.0)"
echo "N=$N, ranks=$NTOTRANKS, threads per rank=$NTHREADS_PER_RANK"
echo "Parameter file: $PARAM_FILE"
echo "Expected: With F=0 and H=0, only D and G remain"
echo "Expected: After 3D FFT, final matrix should be purely real (imaginary parts ≈ 0)"
echo "=========================================="
echo ""

# Create output directory if it doesn't exist
mkdir -p test_hermitian

# Run the program with parameter file
# Redirect all output to test_hermitian directory
mpiexec -n $NTOTRANKS \
        -ppn $NRANKS_PER_NODE \
        --depth=$NTHREADS_PER_RANK \
        --cpu-bind depth \
        ./hermitian_3d_matrix $N $PARAM_FILE 2>&1 | tee test_hermitian/test_hermitian_mode1_plt.log

echo ""
echo "=========================================="
echo "Checking Hermitian Symmetry Verification Results..."
echo "=========================================="
grep -i "hermitian\|symmetry\|imaginary\|real" test_hermitian/test_hermitian_mode1_plt.log | tail -20

echo ""
echo "Checking for verification errors..."
VERIFY_ERRORS=$(grep -i "ERROR.*hermitian\|ERROR.*symmetry" test_hermitian/test_hermitian_mode1_plt.log | wc -l)
if [ "$VERIFY_ERRORS" -gt 0 ]; then
    echo "WARNING: Found $VERIFY_ERRORS Hermitian symmetry verification errors!"
    grep -i "ERROR.*hermitian\|ERROR.*symmetry" test_hermitian/test_hermitian_mode1_plt.log | head -10
else
    echo "SUCCESS: No Hermitian symmetry verification errors found!"
fi

echo ""
echo "Checking final real-space verification..."
grep -i "max_real\|max_imag\|rms_imag\|purely imaginary\|purely real\|NOT OK" test_hermitian/test_hermitian_mode1_plt.log | tail -10

echo ""
echo "Job completed!"
echo "Output files saved to: test_hermitian/"

"""
Performs short term archiving for restart files, history and rpointer
files in the $RUNDIR associated with $CASEROOT.  Normally this script
is called by case.submit on batch systems.

"""

import sys, os, time
os.chdir( '/glade/work/klindsay/cesm22_cases/SMYLE/g.e22.GOMIPECOIAF_JRA-1p4-2018.TL319_g17.SMYLE.005')

_LIBDIR = os.path.join("/glade/work/klindsay/cesm2_tags/cesm2.2.0/cime", "scripts", "Tools")
sys.path.append(_LIBDIR)

from standard_script_setup          import *
from CIME.case import Case

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


###############################################################################
def parse_command_line(args, description):
###############################################################################

    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=description,
                                     formatter_class=argparse.RawTextHelpFormatter)

    CIME.utils.setup_standard_logging_options(parser)

    parser.add_argument("--caseroot", default=os.getcwd(),
                        help="Case directory to build")

    parser.add_argument("--no-incomplete-logs", default=False, action="store_true",
                        help="Whether to archive logs which have been completed or not")

    parser.add_argument("--copy-only", default=False, action="store_true",
                        help="Copy instead of move the files to be archived")

    parser.add_argument("--last-date", default=None,
                        help="WARNING: This option with --force-move may corrupt your run directory! Use at your own risk! "
                        "Last simulation date to archive, specified as 'Year-Month-Day'. "
                        "Year must be specified with 4 digits, while month and day can be specified without zero padding. "
                        "'0003-11-4' would archive at most files for the simulated year 3, month 11, day 4."
                        "This option implies --copy-only unless --force-move is specified ")

    parser.add_argument("--force-move", default=False, action="store_true",
                        help="Move the files even if it's unsafe to do so, dangerous if used with --copy-only.")

    parser.add_argument("--test-all", default=False, action="store_true",
                        help="Run tests of st_archiver functionality on config_arvchive.xml")

    parser.add_argument("--test-case", default=False, action="store_true",
                        help="Run tests of st_archiver functionality on env_arvchive.xml")

    parser.add_argument("--resubmit", default=False, action="store_true",
                        help="If RESUBMIT is set, this performs the resubmissions."
                        "This is primarily meant for use by case.submit")

    args = CIME.utils.parse_args_and_handle_standard_logging_options(args, parser)

    if args.caseroot is not None:
        os.chdir(args.caseroot)

    if args.last_date is not None and args.force_move is False:
        args.copy_only = True

    if args.force_move is True:
        args.copy_only = False

    return (args.caseroot, args.last_date, args.no_incomplete_logs, args.copy_only,
            args.test_all, args.test_case, args.resubmit)


###############################################################################
def _main_func(description):
###############################################################################
    sys.argv.extend([] if "ARGS_FOR_SCRIPT" not in os.environ else os.environ["ARGS_FOR_SCRIPT"].split())
    caseroot, last_date, no_incomplete_logs, copy_only, testall, testcase, resubmit = parse_command_line(sys.argv, description)
    with Case(caseroot, read_only=False) as case:
        if testall:
            success = case.test_st_archive()
        elif testcase:
            success = case.test_env_archive()
        else:
            success = case.case_st_archive(last_date_str=last_date,
                                           archive_incomplete_logs=not no_incomplete_logs,
                                           copy_only=copy_only, resubmit=resubmit)

    sys.exit(0 if success else 1)

###############################################################################

if __name__ == "__main__":
    _main_func(__doc__)

# Function to search for all `.in` files and run the `run-corvus` command
search_and_run() {
    files=$(find . -type f -name "*.in")
    for file in $files; do
        # Start time for the job
        start_time=$(date +%s)

        # Clean up old files (if any)
        rm -rf Corvus1_PYMATGEN/ Corvus2_helper/ Corvus.cfavg.out Corvus.nest

        # Run the Corvus command and redirect output
        echo "Running Corvus on ${file}" >> testing.out 
        run-corvus -i "${file}" >> testing.out 2>&1 || echo "Failed to run-corvus on ${file}" >> testing.out 
        echo "Completed Corvus on ${file}" >> testing.out 
    done
}
